A Transformer reads a sequence, so a picture has to be turned into one. Edu-Patchify cuts the 16 by 16 image into 4 by 4 squares and flattens each: a 4 by 4 grid, 16 tokens, 3 times 4 times 4 = 48 numbers per token. That is the whole of ViT's input stage; everything after it is the machinery a text Transformer already uses. The two Prints are the token block and the grid, and the grid is what you need to fold the tokens back into a picture. The tensor is random, so read the shapes. Turn on Verbose internals in Settings to watch unfold, permute and flatten in the Inspector's Steps tab.

Transformer 讀的是序列，所以得先把圖片變成序列。Edu-Patchify 把 16x16 的影像切成 4x4 的方塊再攤平：4 列 4 欄的網格、16 個 token，每個 token 是 3 乘 4 乘 4 = 48 個數字。ViT 的輸入階段就到這裡為止，後面用的都是文字 Transformer 本來就有的那一套。兩個 Print 分別是 token 區塊和網格，網格是把 token 拼回圖片時要用的。張量是隨機的，所以看形狀就好。在設定裡打開「顯示內部步驟」，檢視器的「步驟」分頁就會逐步顯示 unfold、permute 和 flatten。

Real ViT-Base takes a 224 by 224 image at patch_size 16: 196 tokens of 768 numbers. Same arithmetic, sizes small enough to read here. H and W must both divide by patch_size, or the node refuses the image.

真正的 ViT-Base 吃 224x224 的影像、patch_size 16，也就是 196 個 token、每個 768 個數字。算法一樣，這裡只是把尺寸縮到看得完。H 和 W 都必須能被 patch_size 整除，否則節點會直接報錯。

patch_size is the whole knob: 2 gives 64 tokens of 12 numbers, 8 gives 4 tokens of 192. Token count and token width trade against each other and the total stays 16 times 16 times 3. Set flatten false to keep each patch as C by P by P.

patch_size 就是唯一的旋鈕：設 2 會得到 64 個 12 維 token，設 8 則是 4 個 192 維。token 數和 token 寬度互相消長，總數永遠是 16 乘 16 乘 3。把 flatten 關掉，每個 patch 會保留 C、P、P 的形狀。
